snippet.title: Vultures: Scavengers of Death | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: Salento Valley, post bio-hazard incident, as a VULTURE operative, your mission is to extract material to aid in finding a cure for the infection. Select your agent and prepare for turn-based tactical survival against infected mutants. Find the key to our salvation.
